description: The bar chart illustrates the model evaluation on academic and practical benchmarks, comparing the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across nine different datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis lists the categories, namely GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "Score (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with LLaMA-3-8B-it in blue and Ours (Iterative RLHF) in orange. The scores for LLaMA-3-8B-it range from approximately 18% for Chat-Arena-Hard to 79% for GSM-8K, while Ours (Iterative RLHF) scores range from around 27% for Chat-Arena-Hard to 80% for GSM-8K. The bars are grouped by category, with the two models represented side by side. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond their categorical listing, and no bars are visually emphasized.
